description: List open 1-hour slots in Pacific Time, at least one week out, for Standard Hourly or for the first session of an Executive 1:1 Subscription. Read-only: it holds nothing and changes nothing, and repeated calls return the same slots until one is booked. Usage: call list_services first for valid service ids, then call this before prepare_booking; only slots returned here can be held. Subscription times are on or after January 18, 2027. Returns an array of open slots with start and end times; it does not price or book.

from.description: Optional range start, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2027-01-18. Defaults to the earliest bookable date.

service.description: Service id from list_services; defaults to standard-hourly. For subscription start times, pass executive-subscription. Subscription times are only slots whose recurring day of week and time stays open for 12 months. Standard Hourly times are not valid for booking a subscription.

to.description: Optional range end, ISO 8601 date or datetime, e.g. 2027-02-28. Defaults to a standard search window after the range start.

name: check_availability

earliest.description: Earliest open slot overall, same shape as a slot, or null when none.

message.description: Plain-language note, e.g. when no slots are open in the range.

slots.description: Open 1-hour slots in the range; each has start (ISO 8601 UTC datetime), weekday, display (Pacific Time text), timezone, and durationMinutes.

title: Check availability
